Name: Pomu Rainpuff Companion (Fairy Box Recolor)
Author: Tritan21
Description:
Changes the fairy box trinket from Stardew Valley to resemble the titular vTuber fairy, Pomu Rainpuff.

Although the fairy box item can summon 8 different types of fairy, they will all look like Pomu Rainpuff.

[b][size=4]Who is Pomu?
[/size][/b]
Pomu Rainpuff was a female English Virtual YouTuber affiliated with NIJISANJI EN's first wave "LazuLight", alongside Elira Pendora and Finana Ryugu. She has since "graduated" and no longer streams video games on her channel. Pomu is friendly, cheerful, and mischievous. She is a hardcore otaku who becomes very passionate when discussing her favorite topics, such as maid cafes, or metal gear solid.
[b]
[size=4]Why did I make this mod?[/size][/b]

I really enjoyed watching Pomu's streams and thought this was a good way to immortalize her.

[b][size=4]Incompatibilities?[/size][/b]

Any mods that change the fairy appearance (from the fairy box) will inadvertently break this mod.
